C0500.title: Buying 'Proxy Ordering' Discounts May Constitute Aiding a Crime: Two Individuals Exploited Ordering Loopholes to Illegally Profit Over One Million Yuan
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0500.summary: Starting May 2024, suspect Wang exploited a vulnerability in a fast-food chain's mini-program to convert freely obtained coupons into product redemption codes. He listed these as virtual goods online under the guise of 'proxy ordering' or 'coupon codes,' providing electronic redemption codes to buyers to complete orders.
